items.name: qpu-app
items.title: QPU App host
items.description: The host of an MCP App: reads a tool's ui://qpu/<tool> resource over the MCP endpoint and hosts it through the MCP Apps protocol in a sandboxed frame.
items.docs: import { QpuApp } from '@/components/qpu/app' — <QpuApp tool="processor" args={{ name: 'Willow' }} result={reply.result} mcp="https://qpu.uuidna.com/mcp" /> (the Worker takes no key); against a Payload app's /api/mcp pass apiKey (a payload-mcp-api-keys key the admin made) or html read by your server

items.description: The qpu block of UUID logic for Payload's lexical editor: the shape every tools/call result carries in _meta.payload.
